author: lockRuby
body:
This is my first DTM map and it took me not too long but still was hard to make anyway i present my map "Graleks" to the server. Hope you enjoy it and the map chunks didnt load complete so it may seem small in the first few images but trust me its bigger at the bottom. 
Thanks to scriptingcookies for helping building the grass thing by the lakes. I also designed it after ravaged a little since you guys seem to miss it but this has a lot better terrain. 

I will try the yml myself and the spawnkit is stone sword, normal bow, leather helmet, leather chestplate, golden apple, and 32 arrow along with 64 glass and 64 log. Plays during night

2 teams: Red and Blue, 2 monuments per side

Images
Download
YML (i will do)

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
awesome!
couple suggestions:
make the edges of the big water area in the middle more natural- look at naturally spawned shores and rivers in minecraft, dont just make it a rectangle of water.

if there aren't boats by the water, i'd put a chest with some

add some more structures (put a ruined wall, or a home, or a castle, or something) right now it looks like a naturally spawned minecraft chunk copy/pasted with a couple towers and a few trees/wool added.

replies.author: itaity
replies.body:
Sorry, but your map has been denied, for the following reasons:
  • Lack of structures - besides of the trees and the monument towers, the map doesn't have many structures.
  • Not aesthetically pleasing - The mountains in the corners seems very rough and unnetural, big parts of the maps are just grass with random placed trees, also, the waterfalls don't seems netural.
Of course you can upgrade the map and re-submit it, good luck :)
